cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(cui_date_picker_calendar_worker C)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
enable_testing()
get_filename_component(CUI_SOURCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(CUI_BUILD_NATIVE OFF CACHE BOOL "Portable worker fixture" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}" cui EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
if(NOT TARGET test_date_picker_calendar)
add_executable(test_date_picker_calendar "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/unit/test_date_picker_calendar.c")
target_link_libraries(test_date_picker_calendar PRIVATE cui_software cui)
cui_warnings(test_date_picker_calendar)
add_test(NAME date_picker_calendar COMMAND test_date_picker_calendar)
endif()
if(NOT TARGET date_picker_calendar_guide)
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/docs/DATE_PICKER_CALENDAR.md")
file(READ "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/docs/DATE_PICKER_CALENDAR.md" guide)
string(REGEX MATCH "```c\n([^`]+)```" example "${guide}")
if(NOT CMAKE_MATCH_1)
 message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing DatePicker Calendar C guide example")
endif()
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/date_picker_calendar_guide.c" "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}")
add_library(date_picker_calendar_guide OBJECT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/date_picker_calendar_guide.c")
target_link_libraries(date_picker_calendar_guide PRIVATE cui)
cui_warnings(date_picker_calendar_guide)
endif()
